criteria.name: Attention span reduction
criteria.definition: Design patterns that fragment focus: infinite feeds, short-form loops, autoplay.

criteria.name: Compulsive use
criteria.definition: Variable rewards, streaks and notifications engineered to bring users back.

criteria.name: Reality warping
criteria.definition: Ranking that amplifies sensational, misleading or emotionally charged content.

criteria.name: Isolation
criteria.definition: Personalisation that narrows exposure to differing views and communities.

criteria.name: Financial
criteria.definition: Degree to which revenue depends on maximising time-on-platform and ad reach.

criteria.name: Ownership ideology
criteria.definition: Influence of owners' political or ideological agendas on what is surfaced.
